cases.prompt: Run our Postman collection with Newman in GitHub Actions and publish JUnit results.
expectations: Provides a workflow YAML that installs Node and Newman.
Passes the environment file and keeps secrets in repository secrets, not in the file.
Uploads or publishes the JUnit report even when tests fail.
The job fails when Newman reports failures.

cases.prompt: Write a GitLab CI job for our Newman tests with an HTML report as an artifact.
expectations: Uses a Node image and installs newman and an HTML reporter.
Writes the report to a path listed under artifacts with when: always.
